Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 by both modes i.e. speed post as well as ordinary post with A/D, for which necessary requisites etc. must be filed on or before 27.09.2023, failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.

In the meantime, the order dated 30.10.2021 passed by Sri Chandan Kumar, the learned Judicial Magistrate, 1 st Class, Munger in Complaint Case No.878C of 2020, whereby cognizance has been taken against the petitioner under Sections Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.18296 of 2023(2)
dt.18-09-2023 376, 504 of the I.P.C., shall remain stayed as it has been submitted by the petitioner that from bare perusal of the allegation as alleged in the complaint, it would manifest that it is not a case of rape rather two consenting adults, on their own volition, came together and entered into physical relationship.
